bio.text: Christopher Cabaldon was elected to the California State Senate in 2024 and represents the 3rd Senate District, which includes Wine Country, the Delta, the North Bay and the Sacramento Valley.

Before his election he served two decades as mayor of West Sacramento, and he previously served as vice chancellor of the California Community Colleges and as director of the higher education committee for the State Assembly.
According to his Senate biography, he was the first Filipino American to serve in the California Senate and was appointed to education and environment posts by five governors.
